name: Persistent Serialisability (PSER)
description: A transactional persistency model giving the first formalisation of transactional semantics in the non-volatile-memory setting: it extends serialisability with an orthogonal persist-order axiom over durable transactions. Proven to compile correctly to PARMv8.

catSupport.note: Serialisability plus an orthogonal persist-order axiom: both are per-execution conditions, but no shipped cat model has crash/persist events.
